source.title: Call for Applicants - WEC Leader (September 2020)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) Leader**, as Callum Goodyear is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Callum for the work he has done leading the Committee. 

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Proactivity
* Clear background
* Trustworthiness
* Independence
* Accountability

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **October 10th, 2020, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as Leader of the WEC.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their application which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会负责人招募（2020 年 9 月）
translation.content:
Callum Goodyear 将卸任 **WCA 道德委员会（WEC）负责人**，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Callum 在任期间带领委员会所做的工作。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作，并具备以下条件：

* 主动积极
* 背景清白
* 诚实可靠
* 能够独立判断
* 勇于承担责任

请在 **2020 年 10 月 10 日 23:59 UTC** 前，将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
* 担任 WEC 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WEC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢各位申请和支持。
